criteria.text: Add pure deterministic helper with injected now, 48*60*60*1000, returns original state when unchanged; otherwise one state update adding all candidates with one shared archivedAt timestamp.
Eligibility is strict: only now-lastActivityAt > 48h. Exactly 48h is not eligible. Clock skew/future excluded. Unknown/stale excluded. Roots + workers included.
First successful applyThreads after state read applies it before archivedSet/roster ranking and queues one conflict-aware whole-state save. Repeated same scan no extra write/state identity change.
Handle ~8K candidates below state cap without per-row writes. If save exceeds existing state limits, existing state stays intact/error is surfaced; don't invent partial batching.
Add schema/default/merge/migration support for unarchivedAt; conflict merge takes newest timestamp. Auto eligibility uses max(lastActivityAt, unarchivedAt[id]).

Original scene supports restoring a Colony-archived thread from Archived filter. Restore removes local archive/archiveAt, sets unarchivedAt now, saves once, and immediately returns it to roster/filter with truthful button/title/toast. Manual re-archive clears grace. Harness-archived rows remain immutable/aren't falsely restored.

Prove Rhythm visibility with synthetic large fixture: every Rhythm row survives except proven raw OpenCode alias; pagination/generation not truncated; historical filtering only path-based; after auto archive, recent Rhythm rows occupy deterministic capped roster. Do not alter dedupe unless fixture proves bug.
criteria.test: test/auto-archive.test.mjs plus existing 15,000-record embedded pagination contracts

criteria.text: Existing HUD already shows harnessName on selected card and filter includes Rhythm. Preserve; if test proves sufficient, no new visual badge.

#/colony → #/tasks → #/colony preserves same native WebContentsView, partition, worker/service, documentId, attachment, scene state/camera/localStorage. Departure hides via zero bounds + host.visibility hidden:true; return reuses attachment and unhides/resizes. No second worker.
Redefine renderer cleanup/colony:view:detach as suspend/hide, not full dispose. Main should independently hide on same-document hash departure in case cleanup IPC loses route authority.

Full-document navigation/reload, main/scene renderer death, window close/app quit, profile invalidation, disable, source change, import exclusive lifecycle still fully dispose/revoke/clear as today. Distinguish did-navigate-in-page/in-place from non-same-document main navigation.
Route-gate inventory/actions remains #/colony; suspended non-Colony route cannot call them. Existing channel exact frame/attachment checks remain.
StrictMode replay still reuses attachment. No worker/partition leaks.
Make auto archive strict now-lastActivityAt > 48h; exactly 48h is NOT eligible. Update helper tests, acceptance c2 and copy consistently.
When one batch auto-archives, show exactly one concise notice/toast with count and recovery. Do not toast on repeat unchanged poll.
On native scene suspend, transfer focus to the Rhythm host WebContents so hidden scene keyboard shortcuts cannot fire; block hidden shortcut intent off-route.
Queue latest host visibility when route suspension happens before scene ready/port transfer; flush it after transfer.
Shortcut/help copy says Archive / restore for A.
Mark existing synthetic screenshots explicitly as bridge lifecycle fixtures, remove claims they prove native continuity, and list native capture as packaged verification blocker.

After the packaged app swap, verify the original Bot Crossing HUD is visible; select a Rhythm row and camera landmark; switch from #/colony to another tab and back; assert the same selection and camera remain with no scene reload; observe the over-48-hour archive notice; review and restore from Archived. Smoke the safe default-browser link, custom provider, and attachment drop separately.
